description: Mapa de hidrantes de Montornès del Vallès is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by oslo.geodata.es. Fire-hydrant map of Montornès del Vallès is a set of geographical information that represents the location of the different fire-hydrant distributed by the municipality. The cartography is offered by means of an interactive viewfinder, where for each fire-hydrant, information relative to its state and the type of operation and system is displayed interactively. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Fire-hydrant map of Montornès del Vallès" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Spain, Catalonia, Cataluña, Montornès del Vallès, España, Incendi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
